verses.text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
For I know the thoughts that I think towards you,” says the LORD, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
And hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart. Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this.
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.
For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labour of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls, yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learnt in whatever state I am, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learnt the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need. I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on towards the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time, casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.” My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
The LORD will fulfil that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure. The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
But those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well. Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

“Come to me, all you who labour and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
Rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer.
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapour that appears for a little time and then vanishes away. For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus towards you.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
Accept whatever is brought upon you, and be patient when you suffer humiliation. For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.
I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears. They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent amongst you. You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

To provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory.
For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed towards us.

messages.text: Okunyiiga kitegeeza nti wabadde osuubira ekintu ekirungi. Leeta essuubi eryo eri Katonda; teyeerabidde.
Oluggi oluggaliddwa si lwe kkomerero y'ekkubo. Katonda emirundi mingi agulawo olulala lw'oba otannamanya.
Enteekateeka zo ntono bw'ozigeraageranya ku Katonda by'akulooterako.
Peter yavuba ekiro kyonna naye teyafuna kintu kyonna. Awo Yesu n'amugamba nti, Teeka mu mazzi ag'omunda.
Katonda asobola okuleeta ebirungi mu bintu ebyali bikyamu. Kino yakikola ku Musalaba, era asobola okukikola mu bulamu bwo.
Kikakasa bulungi okunakuwala ku kyataaliwo. Kale Katonda akulage ekyasobola okubaawo.
Okuba nga tekinnaba tekitegeeza nti tekijja kubeerawo. Linda Mukama ng'olina obugumiikiriza.
Omutindo gwo tegupimibwa ku bivaamu. Katonda akwagala, si lwa by'otuuseeko.
Okunyiiga kuyinza okuba omusomesa. Buuza Katonda ky'ayagala akulage mu kino.
Abantu bayinza okukuleka, naye Katonda asigala nga mwesigwa.
Enteekateeka za Ssaalongo Yozefu ez'okubeera mu bulamu obw'emirembe zakyuka ddala. Yali yeesiga, era n'afuuka omukuumi w'Omununula.
Enguudo ziyinza okuba nga zikyuse, naye Katonda akyagenda naawe.
Ebintu bwe bigwa, Katonda akyakuumye ebintu byonna nga biri wamu.
Okwennyika kwo okuwaayo eri Yesu. Nga bwegattiddwa ku Musalaba gwe, tewali kintu kyonna kifiirizibwa.
Leeka ebyo by'otayinza kukyusa, era nnyikira mu Katonda atakyuka.
Okusanga obuzibu olwaleero kiyinza okuba entandikwa y'emikisa gy'enkya.
Obudde bwa Katonda si bwe bwaffe, naye buli kiseera kiba kituufu.
Beera mwesimbu eri Katonda ku ngeri gy'owuliramu. Zabbuli zijjudde okwennyika okw'amazima.
Ne bw'oba nga wakola kyonna ky'osobola naye ne kiba nga tekimala, Katonda agamba nti omumala.
Mary teyategeera buli kimu, naye yakuuma ebintu byonna mu mutima gwe era n'abeesiga.
Okulemererwa si kwe kukoma. Peter yegaana Yesu emirundi esatu n'afuuka olwazi lw'Ekkanisa.
Tandika nate. Ekisa kya Katonda kipya buli lunaku.
Okunyiiga kwe weewulira leero kuyinza okukukuuma ku kintu ky'otandisobodde kulaba.
Bala omukisa ogumu kati. Okusiima kuleetawo essuubi.
Bwe kiba nti ebyo by'osuubira bikulemeredde, leka okwagala kwa Katonda kujjuze ekifo.
Yesu ategeera. Yagaanibwa mu kibuga kye era n'alekebwa mikwano gye.
Weesige Mukama n'omutima gwo gwonna, era toyesigamanga ku kutegeera kwo.
Toli mabega. Oli ku kiseera kya Katonda, si ky'ensi.
Wandiika ebyo bye wabadde osuubira era obiteeke mu maaso ga Katonda ng'osaba.
Ekyo ekirabika ng'okukyama kiyinza okuba ekkubo Katonda lye yali ataddewo.
Ensigo erina okugwa mu ttaka nga tennaba kuzaala bibala.
Okunyiiga kuno kukuleetere okusemberera oyo atanyiiza.
Essuubi mu Katonda teriwangulwa, kubanga okwagala kwe kwateekebwa mu mitima gyaffe.
Wummulamu leero. Enkya osobola okugezaako nate ng'olina amaanyi amapya.
Katonda alaba okufuba nga tewali mulala akirabye. Tewali kintu kyonna kikolebwa mu kwagala ekifiirwa.
Oyinza okubeera omunyiivu ate n'osigala ng'oli musanyufu. Byombi bisobola okubeera mu mutima omwesigwa.
Wa Katonda ebintu ebimenyese. Ye yasinga okukola ebintu ebipya.
Joseph yatundibwa baganda be, kyokka Katonda yakifuula okuwonya eri abangi.
Tokkiriza olunaku lumu oluzibu kukuleetera okulowooza nti obulamu bwo bwonna buzibu.
Sanyukira mu Mukama, era ajja kutegeka ebyo ebiri mu mutima gwo.
Ekikutegekeddwa tekijja kukuyita nga kiyitako, singa ky'ekyo Katonda ky'ayagala.
Saba Our Father mpola, naddala: Ebyo by'oyagala bikolebwe.
Okunyiiga kuggwaawo. Obwesigwa bwa Katonda bumala emirembe gyonna.
Katonda tannamaliriza kukukuuma. Guma amaaso go gabe nga galaba.
Abatukuvu baayita mu bizibu bingi. Baafuuka abatukuvu olw'okubeesiga.
Obulamu bwe butagenda nga bw'oyagala, genda eri oyo akutegekera.
Okkirizibwa okufuna ekirooto ekirala. Katonda ye muwa w'ebirooto ebirungi.
Leeka, era leka Katonda akulembere. Enkola ye bulijjo y'eyo esinga obulungi.
Essuula eno nzibu, naye ye ssuula emu yokka.
Ekiro kino, teeka essuubi lyo mu mikono gya Katonda. Gye bali balina obukuumi okusinga mu mikono gyo.
